newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Compact Metal to offer 59 mln warrants.
newsitem.headline: Compact Metal to offer 59 mln warrants.

text.p: Compact Metal Industries Ltd plans to raise Singapore $39.4 million by issuing 59.4 million warrants in connection with a S$40 million transferable loan facility, DBS Bank Ltd said on Monday.

The proceeds from the issue would be used to fund the building of a new office and warehouse complex, to finance borrowings and increase working capital, DBS said in a statement. DBS is the proposed issue's manager.
The detachable warrants would be offered on the basis of three warrants for every 10 existing ordinary shares held.
They would entitle holders to subscribe for new ordinary shares of S$0.10 each in the firm.
The loan facility would come in two S$20 million tranches, one repayable on fixed interest terms, the other at a floating rate. Repayments were expected to last a maximum of five years.
Approval for the deal was being sought from shareholders and the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
